title: PIREUS: Autonomous Operator Foundry, Hardware Capability Ontology, and Verifiable Reinforcement Learning Compiler Framework for Sounio
description:
PIREUS is an autonomous operator foundry, hardware-capability ontology engine, and verifiable reinforcement learning compiler framework designed for the Sounio programming language ecosystem.

It operates at the intersection of non-associative Cayley-Dickson hypercomplex algebras, formal silicon microarchitecture ontologies (x86_64 AVX-512, NVIDIA SM121 Blackwell, Apple Silicon, and AMD Alveo U250 FPGAs), interactive theorem proving in Lean 4 and Koka, and group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). PIREUS enforces strict, non-delegable semantic authority: external machine learning models propose untrusted mathematical operators and lowering schedules, while Sounio-native executables verify well-formedness, classify equivalence under the GL(4,2) semidirect gauge quotient group, and compute deterministic binary compiler-as-a-reward signals.
